slug: 2025-07-14 Smart Africa co-creates Africa's first Cross-Border Data Exchange Guidelines (Rabat, ADD-chaired CAITA)

facts.fact: Smart Africa's Council of African IT Agencies met in Rabat on 14 July 2025 with 11 member states, Gabon among them, to draft cross-border data exchange guidelines; the document lists Gabon as a participating state, with no act of its own recorded.
